subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words. 

Looking for her father, Minu finally reached the __area where animals are slaughtered for the market__.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Abattoir"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the meaning of the given word:

__
 
• **Abattoir -** a place where animals are butchered

 
 
• ***Eg.*** Mr. Foley worked previously at a pig *abattoir *and reckoned he was beyond such queasiness.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's learn some other idioms:

 
• **Archive *(idiom)* -** a place in which public records or historical materials (such as documents) are preserved

 
 
• ***Eg. ***an *archive* of historical manuscripts
 
 
 
• **Arsenal (*idiom) *- **an establishment for the manufacture or storage of arms and military equipment
 
 
• ***Eg.*** The city is home to a federal *arsenal.*
 
 
 
• **Apiary *(idiom)* - **a place where bees are kept
 
 
• ***Eg.*** An *apiary* was built at Lamborghini Park back in 2016 as part of the company’s efforts to help carry out environmental biomonitoring activity.
